**Daily Devotional**

**May 1**

*8 But ye shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you: and ye shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judaea, and in Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth. (Acts 1:8 KJV)*

The Greek word used for "power" here is "DUNAMIS," and it means "miraculous power" according to Strong's Concordance. This shows that the Holy Ghost is the power available to us Christians. It is the very power that Jesus had, to perform all the miracles that He did (Acts 10:38), and that very power is in every Christian that has been born again, and baptized in the name of the Father, Son and Holy Ghost (Matthew 28:19). This power is what allowed the disciples to heal the sick and do all the other miracles that they did, and gave them the power to be effective witnesses for Jesus (Mark 16:20).

This verse makes it clear that Jesus was saying that the Gospel of Salvation would be given to the Gentiles, but it still caused great controversy when it happened and was missed by the Jews, and very hard for them to believe (Acts 10:1-12, 34). The Salvation of the Gentiles was also prophesied by the Old Testament prophets many times, but was not understood by the Jews. Thank you Jesus for saving us Gentiles.

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
